operating_notes.text: Maize Processing division segment results recovered to ₹165.61 Cr in Q4FY26 from ₹43.61 Cr YoY.
Full year FY26 finance costs rose 64.3% YoY to ₹27.51 Cr.
Maize Processing segment result recovered to ₹168.07 Cr in Q2FY27 from ₹6.99 Cr YoY.
Other Agro Processing revenue fell to ₹195.85 Cr in Q2FY27 from ₹713.31 Cr YoY.
Finance costs decreased 65% YoY to ₹3.21 Cr in Q2FY27.
Long term bank facilities of ₹649.00 Cr upgraded by Crisil to AA/Stable from AA-/Stable.
